title: Fold-internal residualization (the UMFI-LR preprocessing) — residualize_fit
text: anchor every column j, b_j = Cov(x_i, x_j) / Var(x_i) a_j = mean(x_j) - b_j * mean(x_i), computed rows passed residualize_fit(). residualized column x_j - a_j - b_j * x_i. Two deterministic rules cover degenerate cases (specification Section 5.1): anchor constant fitting rows (max == min, tested exactly), slopes set zero, intercepts become column means, warning class sharedimp_constant_anchor raised. column constant gets slope zero value intercept. column j (numerically) exact affine function anchor fitting rows, .e. residual sum squares 1e-10 times total sum squares, flagged collinear residual set exactly 0 residualize_apply(), fitting new rows alike. column kept, representations always p p - 1 columns. noise ever injected column ever dropped.

code: ols <- sharedimp_learner(   fit = function(x, y) stats::lm.fit(cbind(1, x), y),   predict = function(model, x) {     beta <- model$coefficients     beta[is.na(beta)] <- 0     drop(cbind(1, x) %*% beta)   },   label = "OLS via lm.fit" ) set.seed(1) x <- matrix(rnorm(200), 50, 4, dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("x", 1:4))) y <- x[, 1] + rnorm(50) shared_importance(x, y, learner = ols, v = 3, seed = 1) #> <sharedimp_result> #>   task:       regression #>   learner:    OLS via lm.fit #>   metric:     mse (minimize); score = -mse, importance = score_full - score_reduced #>   resampling: 3-fold cross-validation (1 repeat) #>  #> # A tibble: 4 × 6 #>   feature importance importance_std score_full score_reduced n_splits #>   <chr>        <dbl>          <dbl>      <dbl>         <dbl>    <int> #> 1 x1          0.365          0.874       -1.70         -2.07        3 #> 2 x2         -0.0707         0.0569      -1.70         -1.63        3 #> 3 x3          0.0961         0.0603      -1.70         -1.80        3 #> 4 x4         -0.189          0.455       -1.70         -1.51        3

title: sharedimp 0.1.0
text: Initial release, following common R/Python specification v0.1 (docs/specification.md, reconciled sharedimp-py 2026-11-13). shared_importance(): UMFI-LR fold-internal residualization, paired full/reduced --sample evaluation, scores oriented greater--better, importance = score_full - score_reduced, truncation negative values, per-split results, reproducible seed. Common output schema: feature, importance, importance_std, score_full, score_reduced, n_splits; per split feature, split, n_train, n_test, score_full, score_reduced, importance (+ id, id2, error). Full representation keeps anchor original column position; exactly collinear columns get residual exactly zero kept. Regression, binary multiclass classification; built-"rand_forest" (ranger) "linear" learners, parsnip model specification, custom sharedimp_learner(). single predictor compared null model. Metrics via yardstick common names mse, rmse, mae, r2, rsq, log_loss, accuracy, roc_auc, yardstick metric function. Low-level helpers residualize_fit(), residualize_apply(), build_representations(). direction diagnostic part v0.1 API (definitions differed R Python drafts); code kept internal . Cross-language verification record docs/parity/; comparison reference implementation docs/umfi_comparison.md. Docker image (Dockerfile, rocker/r-ver base) published ghcr.io/dsc-chiba-u/sharedimp-r koki/sharedimp-r .github/workflows/build_test_push.yml; build runs test suite docker/smoke-test.R.
